name: Calculator
description: An everyday calculator that turns into a graphing one. Basic mode handles the daily sums; Advanced adds a scientific keypad and plots any number of functions of x on a pannable, zoomable graph you can tap to trace. The ☰ button in its header converts measurements — km to miles, °C to °F, kg to pounds, and more.
details:
Calculator opens in Basic mode: a plain, quick calculator with the keys you'd expect and nothing you don't. Type a sum and the answer appears underneath as you go, before you even press =. Brackets get their own key that knows whether to open or close, and every finished sum is kept in the history behind the clock icon — tap one to put it back on the entry line.

Switch to Advanced and it becomes a graphing calculator. The keypad grows sin, cos and tan (with inverses behind the 2nd key), ln, log, roots, powers, factorials, π, e, nCr and a DEG/RAD toggle that everything follows. Type a function of x — x^2 - 3, sin(x), 1/x — press Plot, and it's drawn on the graph. Plot as many as you like: each gets its own colour, can be hidden or edited, and stays put between sessions. Drag the graph to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom, and tap anywhere to drop a trace line that reads out what every curve is worth at that x.

The ☰ button in the header opens a unit converter that works the same in both modes. Pick a category — length, weight, temperature, speed, area, volume, time, data, pressure, energy or angle — type a value, and read it back in any other unit, with the full table underneath. Send any result straight to the calculator with one tap.

Everything is stored locally on your device.
